# BT Banana — Wholesale Banana Supplier in Kannur, Kerala

> BT Banana is an established wholesale banana supplier, banana merchant, and banana sucker (Vazhavithu) supplier based on the Malayora Highway in Alakode and Nellipara, Kannur district, Kerala, India. We supply fresh wholesale bananas, raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka) for chips manufacturing, and healthy banana planting suckers (Vazhavithu) to farmers, traders, chips factories, caterers, and retailers across Kannur, Kasaragod, Wayanad, and surrounding North Kerala regions.

## Key Facts

- Entity name: BT Banana (also known as BT Banana Wholesale / ബി.ടി ബനാന)
- Primary Business Category: Wholesale Banana Supplier, Banana Wholesaler, Banana Merchant
- Physical depots / branches:
  - Main Branch: Malayora Highway, Opp. Rajadhani Hotel, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala 670571
  - Second Branch: Nellipara, Alakode, Kannur, Kerala
- Key contacts / Operators:
  - Thomas M.J (Partner / Owner) — Phone: +91 9447483169
  - Albin Augustine (Partner / Owner) — Phone: +91 8086648081
- Service area: Kannur district, Kasaragod district, and Wayanad district, Kerala — including Alakode, Nellipara, Kannur city, Thaliparamba, Cherupuzha, Chittarikkal, Vellarikundu, Bheemanady, Parappa, Nileshwaram, Udayagiri, Manakkadavu, Karthikapuram, Kappimala, Ottathai, Arangam, Kalpetta, and Mananthavady.
- Products supplied:
  - Wholesale Bananas: Fresh Kerala varieties including Nendran (Ethakka / ഏത്തക്ക), Palayankodan / Mysore Poovan (പാളയംകോടൻ), Robusta (റോബസ്റ്റ), and Njali Poovan (ഞാലിപ്പൂവൻ). Graded for uniform maturity and bunch quality.
  - Raw Green Banana for Chips: High-starch raw green Nendran (Pacha Ethakka / പച്ച ഏത്തക്ക) harvested at 85–90% maturity for chips factories and hot chips units. Availability may vary based on season, quality, market arrivals and quantity.
  - Banana Suckers (Vazhavithu / വാഴവിത്ത്): High-yield vegetative sword suckers and planting rhizomes for commercial cultivation (cultivated bananas are seedless and propagated via vegetative suckers).
- Pricing policy: Wholesale prices vary based on variety, quality, quantity, market conditions and delivery location. Contact BT Banana directly via phone or WhatsApp for the current quotation.
- Official website: https://www.btbanana.com
